stable103/overmare-terminal.not-yours/entry: The termianl does not respond to you.
stable103/overmare-terminal.nothing-to-do/entry: The terminal seems to be asleep. You don't see any way to wake it up.
stable103/overmare-terminal.player-options/activate: The console floods with arcane light, lines of text run through the screen. Suddenly, the ground starts shaking. The screen becomes dark. A notification appears. Sentinel is activated. Its army woke up, and is waiting for your command.
stable103/overmare-terminal.player-options/destroy: The console floods with arcane light, lines of text run through the screen. Suddenly, the whole Stabke starts to shake. After a short while, the shaking stops. The screen becomes dark. And a message appear, confirming that Sentinel has been permanently disabled.
stable103/overmare-terminal.player-options/entry: The console recognizes the imprint the moment you're close enough. Sentinel is waiting for you to wake it up.
